reviewSummaryJa: 固定WEBは2:13のフラム・アビ（ティルス王が送る熟練者）と4:11のフラム（ソロモンの神殿用具を作り仕事を終えた職人）を、4:16で再びフラム・アビと呼び、同じ神殿用具作りの続きとして記します。2:13–14の職人と4:11/16の職人を同一の書内人物として扱うことは強く支持されますが、「同一人物」「別名」と明示する一文はありません。既存の二ID間で限定付き同一人物/別名関係を提案するのが適切で、新規IDやティルス王IDへの統合は支持されません。

witnesses.text: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.
Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because the LORD loves his people, he has made you king over them.”

Huram continued, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for the LORD and a house for his kingdom.
Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,

the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.
Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God’s house:
Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for the LORD’s house, of bright bronze.

primaryAssessment.artisanIdentity: 2:13 identifies Huram-abi as the skilled person sent; 2:14 continues with that person and gives parentage and skills. 4:11 names Huram as maker of utensils and says the work for Solomon’s house was finished. 4:16 names Huram-abi as making further vessels for Solomon’s house. The repeated distinctive name and continuous temple-work setting support one artisan, although the text does not explicitly cross-identify 2:13 with 4:11.
primaryAssessment.kingSeparation: 2:3 and 2:11 explicitly call Huram king of Tyre; 2:13 distinguishes the artisan as the skilled man the king says he has sent. The sender and sent artisan are separate referents. Keep person:hiram_1532 separate from both artisan records.
primaryAssessment.crossBookCaution: Do not use 1 Kings’ different maternal-tribe wording to force or deny the 2 Chronicles identity. The decision here is limited to the two 2 Chronicles artisan records.
primaryAssessment.nameCaution: Huram/Hiram transliteration and Huram-abi support an alias relation in this context; do not elevate “Huram-abi means my father / nickname” to an established fact. MHC explicitly marks “probably a sort of nickname” as conjecture.

MHC.textRead: MHC says at verse 16 “Huram, his father,” then speculates it was “Probably ... a sort of nickname”; it further says the king of Tyre called him Huram Abi and Solomon called him his. This directly reflects the artisan-name association but its explanation of the name is conjectural, not primary-text certainty. The imported record is marked unreviewed and spoilerSafe=false, so it must not be surfaced as unqualified reader copy.
MHC.roleInDecision: secondary corroboration for treating the worker named Huram in 4:11 and Huram-abi in 4:16 as one artisan; not the sole proof and not evidence for the Tyre king being the artisan.

JFB_2_13.textRead: 13-14. I have sent a cunning man--(See on 1Ki 7:13-51).
JFB_2_13.roleInDecision: cross-reference to 1 Kings 7:13–51 only; does not independently state the 2 Chronicles identity or nickname.

JFB_4_11.roleInDecision: cross-reference to 1 Kings 7:40 only; no explicit identity argument.

gateAssessment.2CH2:13: The name Huram-abi and the fact that the king sent a skillful man are available at this gate. Do not state parentage, Danite maternal lineage, or the full skill list until 2:14.
gateAssessment.2CH4:11: At this verse, the person is called Huram and the pots, shovels, basins, and completion of his work are stated. Do not show the 4:16 bronze detail in a fact gated to 4:11.
gateAssessment.2CH4:16: This verse explicitly repeats Huram-abi and specifies bright bronze vessels. It is the safest gate to expose the 4:11↔2:13 likely same-artisan link and the Huram-abi form on the 4:11 record, with inference wording retained.
gateAssessment.2CH2:3,11,12: These are the Tyre king’s own correspondence and must remain on the separate king record; the artisan is the person the king sends at 2:13.

recommendationJa: 既存ID person:huram_1575 と person:hiram_1533 は「歴代誌下の同一職人とみられる」という限定付きの書内別名/同一人物関係で結ぶことを支持します。確度は高いものの、根拠は名の反復と神殿用具作業の文脈による同定で、本文に明示された別名説明ではありません。2:13ではフラム・アビの名と派遣だけ、2:14で親子・技能、4:11でフラムの作業、4:16でフラム・アビ再表記・青銅の器具をそれぞれの節ゲートで表示してください。person:hiram_1532（ティルス王）は別人のままです。
